detail.longDescription:
Does anyone have a #web browser bookmarking system they swear by? I research and read a lot for work and my own interests and I am both a tab and bookmark hoarder and it is a Problem. My saved links span sites, articles, images, videos, technical documentation.... you name it.

Preferably something I could #selfhost but open to considering paid services if they fit my criteria well enough. 

I cannot dedicate time to sorting, tagging, or otherwise organizing links - I have tried it before and always commit to it for a day and then get overwhelmed by the sheer quantity. Or I get stuck in a cycle of constantly optimizing my tagging/folder system. There is no in-between. 

Has to be low-friction to save a bookmark but I also need some search functionality for sifting through links to find what I need.

Ideally I could see what links I use frequently vs less frequently for occasional pruning.

I've considered building my own app for this and have various prototypes in different stages of disarray. Just wondering if there's anything out there I should give a try before possibly re-inventing another wheel specifically shaped for my brain.

Things I have tried:
- Raindrop
- An Org file
- Built-in browser bookmarking tools
- Texting myself links

#webdev #research #selfhosting
